chunks: They ask you for a ruling. Say: 'Allah gives you a ruling concerning the Kalalah.'
If a man dies and leaves no child, but has a sister, then she gets half of what he left. And he inherits her if she leaves no child.
If there are two sisters, they get two-thirds of what he left. And if there are brothers and sisters, the male gets the share of two females.
Allah makes clear to you [His rulings] lest you go astray. And Allah is Knowing of all things.

key_terms.الْكَلَالَةِ: Kalalah, a person who dies without direct descendants (children or parents)

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of a sister when her brother dies childless?
ai.summary: This verse, known as Ayat al-Kalalah, provides the definitive inheritance distribution for a deceased person lacking direct ascendants or descendants, a scenario that prompted the Quraysh to seek clarification from the Prophet. It establishes the shares for sisters and the general principle of the male receiving double the share of the female among siblings, serving as a key text in Shia jurisprudence for deriving rules of 'Asabah' (residuary heirs).
